title: Coursebook backend RPC v2
description: Transport-neutral command contract between the Desktop half, the Coursebook tools and the Python backend. v2 is additive over v1: it keeps every v1 method and payload and adds the library, lesson-page/run, enrollment-lifecycle, artifact-download, jobs-list, notebook-update and binding-abandon methods those screens need, plus the v2 error catalog reference. The same envelope is used over HTTP (POST /api/plugins/coursebook/rpc) and from in-process callers.

methods.description: Per-method payload contracts. `request` validates envelope.payload; `response` validates envelope.result on success.
